title: TEMPO: Learning Temporal Context for Dynamic Robot Manipulation
title_zh: TEMPO：学习时序上下文以实现动态机器人操作
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance in quasi-static manipulation, but struggle in dynamic manipulation tasks because they operate on a single observation at inference time. We identify two representational failures that underlie this limitation. The first is motion ambiguity, where a single observation does not include scene dynamics and therefore cannot anticipate the future state of moving objects. The second is state aliasing, where visually similar observations from different points in a task require different actions. We argue that these failures persist regardless of model scale and inference latency, showing that the bottleneck is missing temporal context rather than model capacity. Based on this insight, we propose TEMPO, which augments a pretrained VLA with two temporal inputs: a motion summary extracted from a frozen video foundation model to resolve motion ambiguity and a compact proprioceptive history to resolve state aliasing. TEMPO requires no modification to the backbone and adds minimal compute overhead at training or deployment. Across four dynamic manipulation tasks, it improves Bottle Handover success from 44% to 74% and is the only method that solves state aliasing. Probing and ablation studies confirm that each temporal signal independently addresses its corresponding failure. We further release TEMPO-Bench, a benchmark of over 50k annotated frames for evaluating motion-aware robot perception in both regression and multiple-choice formats.   Project Website: https://tempo-robot.github.io/
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在准静态操作中取得了令人瞩目的性能，但在动态操作任务中表现不佳，因为它们在推理时仅基于单帧观测。我们识别出导致这一局限的两个表征失败。第一个是运动模糊性，即单帧观测不包含场景动态，因此无法预测运动物体的未来状态。第二个是状态混叠，即任务中不同时间点视觉上相似的观测需要不同的动作。我们认为这些失败无论模型规模与推理延迟如何都持续存在，表明瓶颈在于缺失的时序上下文而非模型容量。基于这一洞见，我们提出 TEMPO，它通过两个时序输入增强预训练的 VLA：一个从冻结视频基础模型提取的运动摘要以解决运动模糊性，以及一个紧凑的本体感受历史以解决状态混叠。TEMPO 无需修改主干网络，在训练或部署时仅增加极少的计算开销。在四个动态操作任务中，它将瓶子交接的成功率从 44% 提升至 74%，并且是唯一解决状态混叠的方法。探测与消融研究证实，每个时序信号独立地解决了其对应的失败。我们进一步发布了 TEMPO-Bench，一个包含超过 5 万标注帧的基准，用于以回归和多项选择形式评估运动感知机器人感知。项目网站：https://tempo-robot.github.io/
tldr_zh: TEMPO 为 VLA 添加时序输入，解决动态操作中的运动模糊与状态混叠。
cover_zh: 单帧观测不够用？TEMPO 让机器人动态操作成功率飙升
